events.summary: Solid first cut backed by IUCN Red List, Wikipedia, UF/IFAS (ST350 genus fact sheet), Missouri Botanical Garden, Palmpedia, NTBG, and South Florida Plant Guide. Confidence is high on origin, morphology, conservation status, and growing conditions. Modest uncertainty on exact spacing recommendation and whether a dedicated UF/IFAS fact sheet for L. lontaroides specifically (vs. the genus page on L. loddigesii) exists.
